# Lab 14.4: Autonomous Embedding Generation & AI.SEARCH

## What We Are Going to Do
Declare an embedding column that BigQuery fills and keeps up to date by itself, then search it with AI.SEARCH.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Create the table.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE lab14.products (
  name STRING,
  description STRING,
  description_embedding STRUCT&lt;result ARRAY&lt;FLOAT64&gt;, status STRING&gt;
    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (AI.EMBED(description, model =&gt; 'embeddinggemma-300m'))
    STORED OPTIONS (asynchronous = TRUE)
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] Insert only the source columns.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">INSERT INTO lab14.products (name, description)
SELECT name, CONCAT(name, '. Category: ', category, '. Brand: ', brand)
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
LIMIT 2000;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[SQL] Watch the embeddings fill in.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,
       COUNTIF(description_embedding.status = '' AND description_embedding.result IS NOT NULL) AS embedded
FROM lab14.products;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Run it again after a minute. A background job generates the embeddings.

4. **[SQL] Search without touching embeddings.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT base.name, distance
FROM AI.SEARCH(TABLE lab14.products, 'description', 'warm winter jacket for women', top_k =&gt; 5);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   AI.SEARCH embeds the query with the same model automatically.

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
